provenance: Downloaded existing logo artwork unchanged; no logos drawn, approximated, generated, or substituted with letters.
limitations: The source catalog contains recognizable historical and current versions; no claim that every version is the latest brand-guideline version.
Logo copyrights and trademarks remain with their respective owners; dataset software license does not grant a separate trademark license.
Porsche, Koenigsegg, Aston Martin, Bentley, Mercedes-Benz combine a light/colour emblem with a dark lower wordmark; recommended emblem crop bounds are provided for charcoal cards.
